'''Sector 1459''' was a region of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Umbra Club]], seedy, underworld [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] den, was operated within Sector 1459.<ref name="UABS" />
